title: Cycling Fitness and Fatigue Balance
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powermeter:interval
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(training_load) as daily_load by _time
| streamstats window=42 avg(daily_load) as fitness
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_load) as fatigue
| eval form=round(fitness-fatigue,1)
description: Trends long-term fitness against short-term fatigue to estimate your form, guiding when to push and when to taper.
value: The fitness-minus-fatigue balance predicts readiness; watching it helps you peak for events and avoid overtraining.
implementation: Ingest daily training load into `index=personal`; compute rolling fitness and fatigue and trend the difference.
visualization: Line chart of fitness, fatigue, and resulting form.
grandmaExplanation: It balances your long-term fitness against recent tiredness to show your form, so you know when to push or rest.
